title: Agent tools: validate structural input (z.unknown/z.any) to prevent crash/corruption (generalize 1363)
description:
DONE. Generalized the 1363 doc_load fix across the agent command surface.

HARDENED (tightened schema + handler guard):
- doc_load: schema document:z.unknown() kept loose (documented why); handler routes through normalizeAgentDoc — rejects non-object w/ clear error; backfills id/properties/scenes(drop scenes w/o timeline.layers; backfill 1 default if none)/library.items. Idempotent on valid docs.
- file_load_fla: flaBase64:z.string() correct; handler routes loaded doc through SAME normalizeAgentDoc before pushDoc (1363 fix now covers BOTH doc-replacement boundaries). loadFla throws clear error on bad archive.
- stage_update.updates: schema z.record->enumerated DisplayObjectUpdatesSchema (unknown keys stripped; shape/filters/warp NOT exposed); handler adds sanitizeDisplayObjectUpdates (whitelist+type-check, wrong-typed known field rejected). colorEffect->ColorEffectInputSchema.
- timeline_set_tween.props: schema z.record->enumerated TweenPropsSchema; handler already typeof-guarded.

LEFT LOOSE (documented): jsfl_run.source (escape hatch, 1282); all *Result z.unknown/z.any (OUTPUT to model, cannot crash/corrupt doc).

ARCH: /__agent bridge skips Zod (dispatchAgentCommand direct), so handler guards are the universal defense; schema tightening protects MCP/agent-chat. Both layers applied.

TESTS: agent-protocol 110 (+7); authoring-ui registry 127 (+15 task-1367). Full ordered build green. 2 pre-existing core/fla fixture failures unrelated (zero core source touched).
DOCS: docs/19-agent-interface.md new 'Structural-input validation model' subsection.
